findings.title: The binding note says every DS12110 citation in it is Rev 8, but its own R5-MCU-04 obligation cites Rev 11 Table 109
findings.contradicts: r10_binding_note.json sources.mcu_revision (line 527): 'every DS12110 citation in this note is Rev 8 (April 2021), revision V electrical chapter (section 7; the LCSC copy is byte-identical); Rev 11 and RM0433 were not re-read in round 19 (R19-MCU-02)'. The same note, firmware_obligations[29] (line 601, 'Audit2 direct PC0/PC5 ... Other unprotected sense faults (R5-MCU-04)'): '... the 4.0 V ADC-mode maximum and the 6.0 V FT cap were read from Rev 11 Table 109 in round 14 and are kept as design limits (Inference: not in Rev 8, Rev 11 not re-read)'. docs/M3_R10.md 'Sources and datasheet revisions' itself lists these two limits as labelled Rev 11 exceptions, so the note's 'every ... is Rev 8' has no carve-out and is false.
findings.evidence: git show 816038c:m3_design/assembly_review/sources/r10_design/r10_binding_note.json: sources.mcu_revision (generated from m3_design/r10_sch_check.py lines 242-243) and firmware_obligations[29] (generated from r10_sch_check.py line 307) both present; the note's board_sha256 is a0ec075e..., so this is the current generated note. Text search: 'Rev 11 Table 109' occurs once in the note, inside a DS12110 limit citation. Not raised in round 23 (R23-DOCS_BINDING-04 dealt with AGENTS / ORDERING / parts_qualification, and its fix narrowed AGENTS to 'pin_table and the binding note cite Rev 8' while M3_R10 lists the Rev 11 limits as labelled), and absent from the round 24-26 triage observations (grep 'Rev 11', 'Table 109', 'every DS12110 citation' in sources/r10_review/round2[3-6]_triage*: no hit).
findings.impact: Low: a reader trusting the sources line would look up 'Table 109' in the Rev 8 copy, where it is a different table; the FT 6.0 V and ADC-mode 4.0 V limits are the only Rev 11 basis in the note. No hardware or firmware behaviour changes.
findings.concrete_fix: Generator text only (r10_sch_check.py, regenerate the note; the board is unchanged): 'every DS12110 citation in this note is Rev 8 (April 2021) ..., except the two design limits labelled as read from Rev 11 Table 109 in round 14 (the 6.0 V FT cap and the 4.0 V ADC-mode maximum, R5-MCU-04 obligation; Inference, not re-read)'. Optionally pin the new words in test_r23_binding_note_rules_and_pin_table.

observations: U1 pad nets on the board (100 pads), the schematic netlist (schematic.net.xml) and pin_table.tsv r10_net agree on all 100 pins; the binding note's u1_pins port / net / mode equal pin_table port / r10_net / mode_af on all 100 rows; pin_table and circuit.json hashes in the note match the files, netlist hash 762bc13d... matches.

Every LQFP100 pin number to pin name in pin_table matches DS12110 Rev 8 Table 9 (pp. 64-88); every 'Table 9 p. N' and 'Table 10-14 p. M' page citation in pin_table's source column matches the page on which that pin's row appears.

AFs and ADC channels used (TIM5 AF2, USART3 / USART6 / UART7 AF7, UART5 AF14, QUADSPI AF9 / AF10, SPI1 AF5, SPI3 AF6, I2C1 AF4, OTG_FS AF10; PC0 ADC123_INP10, PA6 ADC12_INP3, PC5 ADC12_INP8, PB1 ADC12_INP5) match DS12110 Rev 8; PC1 RTC_TAMP3 / WKUP5 and the trace pins (PE2 TRACECLK, PC1 TRACED0, PE4 TRACED1) as the note states.

R23 rule 4 (and M3_R10 Firmware rule 4) pairs '1.128 / 1.063 A' with '0.93-1.01x the 1.125 A floor'; those two currents give 0.945-1.003x; the 0.93-1.01x range is the envelope of round23_safety_severity_check.md's wider case table (including -20 C and Q120's 0.04 ohm removed: 1.043-1.137 A), so it is a conservative envelope, not counted.

Rule 12's harmonic rule names SPI3 / QSPI / timer clocks; the 25 MHz HSE crystal itself has its 63rd harmonic at 1575.0 MHz (0.42 MHz from L1). R10 has no on-board GNSS and the rule is labelled Inference; noted only.
PC14 drives R162 1 kohm into Q123's gate (3.3 mA initial edge current against Table 159's 3 mA test point); already recorded as unmeasured in parts_qualification.md (D-R12-01), not counted.

The PA6 window's lower edge with 1 % R60 / R61 is VLOGIC 4.75 V (BAT_IN about 4.84-4.91 V with the 0.09-0.16 V drop), still above U9's 4.80 V BAT_IN corner; rule 8 already says the window is to be qualified with divider and ADC tolerances.

fix_verification.measurement: Independent worst-corner EN model (R80 / R165 474.7 k, R81 297 k, C87 0.72 x 220 nF, EN 0.1 uA out, D402 50 nA, VUVLO(F) 1.116 V; TI SLVSFC9C p. 9 thresholds read from the cached PDF): single drop-out 10.345 / 20.111 / 26.023 ms at 6.0 / 7.4 / 8.4 V, 8.066 ms at 5.713 V, 6.300 ms at 5.5 V; EN 1.4014 V at 6.0 V; nominal 18.9 / 32.8 / 41.1 ms; late-block limit 7.501 ms at 5.713 V, 7.629 at 5.73, 5.871 at 5.5, 9.594 at 6.0; EN at the 7 ms line 1.1295 V (5.713) / 1.1330 V (5.73); the 7 ms line holds down to 5.6465 V; periodic trip fractions at 5.713 V 19.7 % (fast limit) / 19.6 / 18.6 / 17.4 / 14.8 / 11.4 / 4.5 % at 0.1 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 ms, at 6.0 V 24.4 % / 24.3 % to 8.3 % at 9.9 ms; 3 x 4 ms with 0.2 ms closures 1.0245 V at 5.713 V; exchange identity C(O(v)) - O(C(v)) = (1-a)(1-b)(vc-vo) verified algebraically; turn-on 30.3-130.3 ms.

Re-solved V = 7.4 - 0.15 (V / R + 7.68 + 13.06409 / V): healthy 5.7132 V at 1.2787 A (R 4.4678 ohm), match shorted 5.5576 V (2.4678 ohm), cold 5.5555 V (2.4528 ohm), match and leads shorted cold 5.5084 V (2.1528 ohm); parts_budget four-stall loaded_pack_V 5.71319 (primary FETs) / 5.71116 (typical hot); U9 BAT_IN turn-off corner 4.802 V (4.778 V without D402); PA6 0.44-0.47 V x 11 = 4.84-5.17 V; hold-up 0.1034-0.1643 ms (11.249-13.064 W) and 0.2906-0.4303 ms shed (4.295-4.650 W) at 300.8 uF to 3.8 V; ratios to break-to-3.8 V hold-up 0.22-0.31.

GND vias 0.5 / 0.3 mm present at (7.4, 16.5) and (7.4, 20.0); U1 PC6 / PC7 nets AUX_TX_MCU / AUX_RX_MCU unchanged through R471 / R470 to J440.3 / J440.4; port pin order pin 3 board TXO, pin 4 board RXI as the note states.
